{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

df['biomarker_baseline'] = pd.to_numeric(df['biomarker_baseline'], errors='coerce')

df_clean = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999].copy()

df_dedup = df_clean.loc[df_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the distribution of severity across arms
table = pd.crosstab(df_dedup['arm'], df_dedup['severity'])
print(table)

# Compute raw response rates by arm
treatment_resp = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_resp = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()
raw_diff = treatment_resp - control_resp

print(f'Treatment response rate: {treatment_resp:.4f}')
print(f'Control response rate: {control_resp:.4f}')
print(f'Raw difference (treatment - control): {raw_diff:.4f}')"}
